declaration.method: One draw per save and player against his chance by year (real_prospects.declaration_year). 2027: board consensus blended with the college model, model weight = games / (games + 20). Later years: the model's split of what is left, or for ranked players the history of returning ranked players. Recruits: history by recruiting rank. Internationals: board rank, else a stated prior.

input_mapping.notes: input = intercept + sum(coef * (feature - mean) / sd) + years_coef * (years - 3) + log_pick_coef * (ln(pick) - 3); entry uses years = 0.

source: Barttorvik (T-Rank) college player and team tables, seasons 2008-2027 (derived values only); public 2027 draft boards and mocks; 247Sports Composite recruit ranks (classes of 2027-2028).
